products.name: Ìyàwó Coral Bridal Set
products.tagline: The full four-piece, made to your day

sizes.label: Full set — necklace, earrings, bracelet, ring

products.description: Four rows of natural coral branch with gold-capped accent beads, finished with a cast-gold coral pendant drop. Necklace, earrings, bracelet and ring, made together so the gold tone matches across all four. This is the set we make most often for traditional weddings, and we make each one to the bride's neckline.
details: Four-row coral branch collar with hand-knotted gold accent beads
Cast 18k gold-plated pendant drop, seven coral settings
Matching earrings, bracelet and adjustable ring included
Cut to your measurement — send it at checkout or we'll call
care: Keep away from perfume, hairspray and body oils — spray before you put it on.
Wipe with a dry cloth after wearing; never soak coral or pearl in water.
Store flat in the Lui'Deo box, not hanging — strung pieces stretch.
Bring it back to us for restringing rather than pulling a loose strand.
